en.headline: AIRSIDE opens Kuromi Starlit Sweet Party with six-metre macaron installation
en.dek: The dessert-themed event at the Kai Tak mall runs until early November, with a bakery experience on selected dates from this weekend and a limited-time themed menu.
body: AIRSIDE in Kai Tak has launched the Kuromi Starlit Sweet Party, turning its second-floor atrium into a dessert-themed space until 8 November.

The centrepiece is a six-metre-tall installation of the Sanrio character seated on a giant pink macaron. There are also photo spots themed around cookies, cream-whisking and toast, plus a pop-up store offering baking-series and Kuromi Dreamy Dessert items, including baker-themed plush keychains.

A Sanrio Characters Bakery Experience, in which staff scent a chosen bread-mascot keychain with the aroma of freshly baked bread, runs on selected dates from 17 October. A limited-time Kuromi-themed menu is available at Terrace in Seaside on the sixth floor until the end of November.

zh.headline: 啟德AIRSIDE呈獻Kuromi魔幻烘焙所 6米馬卡龍裝置
zh.dek: 甜點主題活動至11月初，本周末起有選日烘焙體驗，六樓亦有期間限定主題餐單。
body: 啟德AIRSIDE推出「Kuromi Starlit Sweet Party 魔幻烘焙所」，將二樓中庭化身為甜點主題空間，活動至11月8日。
核心裝置是一座6米高的Kuromi坐在巨型粉紅色馬卡龍上。現場另有曲奇、忌廉及吐司主題拍照點，以及期間限定店，售賣烘焙系列及Kuromi夢幻甜品系列商品，包括麵包師傅造型毛公仔鑰匙扣。
Sanrio角色烘焙體驗由10月17日起於選日進行，職員會為選中的麵包造型公仔鑰匙扣注入新鮮麵包香氣。六樓Terrace in Seaside亦有Kuromi主題餐單，供應至11月底。
